truth_boundary: Semantic preservation is not acoustic support. Exact technique semantics are claimed only when the frozen MusicXML/runtime path preserves the requested identity; generic harmonic preservation does not imply natural/artificial distinction.

generic_harmonic.detail: MusicXML harmonic maps to the generic Harmonic articulation; natural/artificial identity is not preserved.

col_legno.semantic_detail: Direction text is preserved in note technical metadata and emitted as an unsupported-string-technique warning.

sul_ponticello.semantic_detail: Direction text is preserved in note technical metadata and emitted as an unsupported-string-technique warning.

sul_tasto.semantic_detail: Direction text is preserved in note technical metadata and emitted as an unsupported-string-technique warning.

natural_harmonics.semantic_detail: Generic harmonic is preserved, but natural harmonic identity is not distinguished from artificial harmonic.

artificial_harmonics.semantic_detail: Generic harmonic is preserved, but artificial harmonic identity is not distinguished from natural harmonic.

con_sordino.semantic_detail: The frozen MusicXML parser does not preserve a dedicated con-sordino/mute semantic token or unsupported-technique warning.

portamento_transition_variants.semantic_detail: MusicXML glissando/slide map to the Portamento articulation and feed the existing transition path.

promotion_rule: Do not set acoustic_release_approved=true unless the exact technique has semantic_support=true and all required evidence is present and bound to the exact final model manifest and VST3 hashes.
